blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Forensic financial analyst Alexander Cabrera said on Monday that Vice President Sara Duterte’s unexplained wealth could reach P1.5 billion, almost twice his initial estimate of P817.87 million, if he included P475 million in confidential funds and used less conservative estimates of questioned transactions involving the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) and GenCorp Industries […]...
